en.title: Shortest Time to Eat k Apples Starting from the Origin
en.description:
There is one apple at each of several distinct integer coordinates. Starting from 0, you move 1 unit per second and may turn around at any time; an apple is eaten as soon as you reach it. Find the shortest time to eat at least k apples.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k; the second line contains the coordinates. 1≤n≤100000; 1≤k≤n; coordinates are in −10^8..10^8 and pairwise distinct.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
hints: Sort, then enumerate the two ends of every block of k consecutive coordinates; the cost is the distance between the ends plus the distance from 0 to the nearer end, which you visit first.
